calculator.title: Na'urar lissafi
calculator.helpToggle: Yadda alamomi da saituna ke aiki
calculator.signBody: Kuɗin da kuke biya yana da alamar ragi (−); kuɗin da kuke karɓa yana da alamar ƙari (+). Ku ranci R100,000 (PV = +100,000) kuma biyanku zai fito da alamar ragi.
calculator.ppyBody: Biyan kuɗi a shekara da BGN/END: ku danna 2ND sannan N don canza adadin biyan kuɗi a shekara (12, 1, 2, 4); 2ND sannan PV yana sauyawa tsakanin END (biyan kuɗi a ƙarshen kowane lokaci) da BGN (a farko). CPT sannan maɓalli yana lissafa shi; 2ND sannan CPT yana share ƙimomi biyar.
calculator.flowBody: Kwararar kuɗi: ku danna CF, ku rubuta kowane adadi sannan ku danna = don ƙara shi (na farko na yau ne). Sannan ku danna NPV (yana amfani da I/Y a matsayin ƙimar kowane lokaci) ko IRR. 2ND sannan CF yana share jerin.
calculator.cfHint: Ku rubuta adadi, sannan ku danna = don ƙara shi. Ku danna CF don rufewa.
calculator.cptHint: Yanzu ku danna ƙimar da za a lissafa
